description: Issue summary: Over the evening window we observed a sustained elevation in 5xx responses from the hosted API for a single dedicated-tenant (CodaHealth) which correlates with heavy prefetch/concurrent-stream traffic. Impact: ~6-9% of requests return 502/503/504 during the 18:30-21:00 UTC window; multiple live streaming sessions report abrupt disconnects and retries. Expected behavior: error rate should be <0.5% and p99 latency under SLOs. Environment: production US-East cluster serving dedicated pools for CodaHealth. Customer notes that traffic pattern changed to more aggressive prefetch and long-context prompts around the same time.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Tenant pins rw-13b-instruct-v2 and enables aggressive prefetch (concurrency=12) with long prompts (avg 2k tokens)
2) Drive sustained request rate ~150 req/s for 20+ minutes simulating customer workload
3) Observe API gateway 5xx rate, runtime logs for OOMs or eviction churn, and autoscaler activity
logs_and_metrics: Error-rate: baseline ~0.4% -> spike to 6.8% between 18:35-19:40 UTC. p50 latency 210ms -> 430ms; p99 latency 2.4s -> 7.1s. Serving-runtime observed KV-cache eviction rate increase x18 and frequent prefix cache misses. GPU utilization steady ~92% but host NVMe iowait rose to 45% on affected nodes. API gateway queue depth increased by ~3x and connection resets correlated with worker restarts. Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/tenants/codahealth-prefetch and logs: https://logs.redwood/prod?query=SUP-830555
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: prefetch concurrency + long contexts saturating KV cache and causing runtime thrash leading to retries and upstream 5xx
Checked runtime logs: several ephemeral worker processes restarted due to watchdog timeout after repeated prefix load stalls (watchdog traces attached)
Autoscaler behavior: warmup lag observed — new nodes provisioned but joined after 60-90s, creating a period of insufficient serving capacity
Network: no VPC-level packet loss or TLS errors recorded; API gateway shows accept-queue growth and backpressure metrics rising
Reproduced a smaller-scale load on staging with same model and prefetch settings; observed similar elevated eviction churn but fewer 5xx due to larger staging cache capacity
comments: [2026-03-13 19:02] CodaHealth (Alice Tran): We started a heavier prefetch test at 18:30; users are seeing intermittent service errors and streaming disconnects. Can you confirm if anything on your side?
[2026-03-13 19:12] Support (Maya Patel): Logged the ticket and triaging. Can you provide an example request ID? Also asking whether this tenant had a recent model pin change.
[2026-03-13 19:18] CodaHealth (Alice Tran): Example request ids: req_ya2K-18:35:41, req_ya2K-18:42:09. They pinned rw-13b-instruct-v2 yesterday.

[2026-03-13 19:45] SRE (Diego Morales): Correlated provided request IDs with gateway and runtime logs. Observed rapid KV cache eviction and runtime worker restarts tied to prefix load stalls. Autoscaler added nodes but join delay left shortfall window.

[2026-03-13 20:05] Eng (R. Singh): Added to eng queue to evaluate prefetch backpressure heuristic. Noted potential improvement by limiting prefetch concurrency per-tenant when eviction churn exceeds threshold.

[2026-03-13 20:32] Support (Maya Patel): Applied temporary mitigation: requested customer reduce prefetch concurrency from 12 -> 4 and lower concurrent streams. Customer reports immediate drop in 5xx; monitoring continues.
[2026-03-14 09:10] CodaHealth (Alice Tran): After applying the mitigation we see error rates fall back to normal. Thanks — please keep us posted on permanent fixes.

[2026-03-14 11:02] Diego Morales: Engineering proposed plan: 1) tune autoscaler warmup parameters for dedicated pools; 2) implement per-tenant prefetch backpressure limit; 3) KV-cache eviction improvements (LRU tuning). Target ETA for rollout: 2026-03-28.
temporary_workaround: Customer reduced prefetch concurrency from 12 to 4 and limited concurrent streaming sessions. Support enabled fallback routing to spare capacity pool for the tenant during warmup periods.
resolution: Mitigation confirmed: reducing aggressive prefetch reduced eviction churn and 5xx rate. Engineering to deploy autoscaler warmup improvements and a prefetch backpressure mechanism; follow-up rollout scheduled. Ticket remains In Progress until permanent changes are deployed and validated.
postmortem_followup_actions: 1) Autoscaler: decrease node join timeouts and pre-warm nodes for dedicated pools (ENG-762)
2) Runtime: add per-tenant prefetch-concurrency soft limit based on KV-cache pressure (ENG-771)
3) Observability: add alert for KV-cache-eviction-rate > 10x baseline per-tenant (SRE-433)
4) Customer communication: share mitigation steps and ETA for permanent fix (CS-210)
